name: Auspicious Assault
body:
Aura strong divination; CL 15th; Price +2 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

This weapon is always plated with a precious metal and symbols of good fortune.

Once per day as part of an attack against a single target make two attack rolls. If any of the attack rolls hit the target, the single attack is considered to have hit. For each additional successful attack, roll beyond the first, increase the damage of the attack by the base damage dice of the weapon. For instance, if a 7th?level medium sized luckbringer attacked with a 14 Str and a +1 auspicious assault longsword and hit with both attacks, she does 2d8 +3 points of damage with the attack, instead of 1d8 +3 points of damage, before adding any damage modifiers. Precision damage and extra damage from weapon special abilities (such as flaming) are added with damage modifiers and are not increased by this weapon special ability. Only one attack roll can threaten a critical the second roll can only increase the damage by the weapons based dice damage even if it is also a critical threat. A luckbringer can activate this ability a second time per day by expending a moment of chance.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells moment of prescience;
